title: When a member's workout data alone grows past Android's 25 MB backup limit, the phone's backup silently stops and nobody is told
what: Android's own phone backup holds at most 25 MB per app and backs up nothing at all above that, workouts included. The app already measures the size of the workout data, but only uses it to decide how many photos fit. If the workout data itself passes the limit (years of training or a big import), photos simply get no room and the whole backup quietly stops. No message tells the member that their workouts are no longer saved to their Google account.
expected: Before the workout data nears the 25 MB limit, the member sees a plain warning (for example on the backup card) and is pointed to Save my history or the cloud copy, so they never think they are backed up when they are not.
fix_line: Check the workout data size against the backup limit and show a warning on the backup card well before it is reached
